notes.title: Major Hotfix!
notes.content:
[h2]First week of fixes[/h2]

Latte Stand Tycoon + has been out for nearly a week now, and thanks some incredibly helpful feedback from a couple of players a major bug has been found and sorted.

This bug caused some of the players to have their world not "re-activate" after going to sleep, and the screen fading back in.

Now those who were having this issue should be able to load back in and continue playing after going to sleep.

Many apologies for this unforeseen issue for those of you who encountered it.

[h2]Fixes and other adjustments[/h2]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Major[/b] - Fixed a bug that caused some players to experience a breaking of the game when going to sleep.
[*] [b]Major[/b] - Fixed a bug that caused NPCs to not spawn back in after a few days of them spawning in the world.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the gear menu to now display selected gear's info when highlighting.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed bird and cricket ambiance to play during rainy and snowy days.
[*] Fixed a bug that kept the upgrade menu from closing with the close (x) button.
[/list]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stormy days now have random thunder rolls that will play.
[*] Improved the shop menu to better display the current purchase information.
[/list]
